title: Touchscreen controls and usability
summary: Feedback about the touchscreen centers on whether moving many controls into it makes operation convenient or harder to learn and use.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the touchscreen is very good, handy, clear, straightforward, and used regularly.

negative.summary: Negative reviews dislike having everything on the touchscreen and describe the setup as difficult or a nightmare to get used to.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the touchscreen and often note controls being routed through it, but the examples are insufficient to classify them consistently as positive or negative.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are brief or ambiguously phrased, which limits confidence in summarizing the undetermined feedback.
The topic is fairly coherent around touchscreen usability and control placement, but the examples do not provide enough detail to assess specific functions or contexts of use.
